subject: Request for temporary SOC 2 assertion to cover post-report period
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@sierraholdings.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@sierraholdings.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: temporary SOC 2 assertion to cover gap between report and renewal

Hi Sergio,

We're working toward our vendor renewal checklist and noticed Redwood's most recent SOC 2 Type II report ends on 2023-12-31. Our procurement window requires an attestation that there have been no material control changes or, if there are any gaps, an interim assertion covering the period between the report end date and the present.

Could you provide a temporary assertion / attestation letter that:
- References the SOC 2 Type II report dated 2023-12-31
- Confirms whether there have been any material changes to in-scope controls since that date
- Covers the period from 2024-01-01 through today (or provides date range wording we can accept)

We'd like a draft we can review and a target date for execution — procurement has a hard deadline the week of 25 Apr. For context, I'll attach our standard vendor form (see PO request). If you need our procurement contact for DocuSign, that's Samir (cc'd).

Thanks,
Elena

Elena Torres
Senior Vendor Risk Analyst
Sierra Holdings
elena.torres@sierraholdings.com
Attachment: procurement_vendor_form.pdf (stub)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@sierraholdings.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: temporary SOC 2 assertion to cover gap between report and renewal

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear note and timeline. Looping in Laura (Compliance) and Marissa (Security Programs) to prepare a short temporary assertion and confirm whether any material control changes exist.

Planned next steps:
- Laura: draft a temporary assertion that references our SOC 2 Type II (report date 2023-12-31) and provides the requested date-range language
- Marissa: confirm there were no in-scope control changes or list any exceptions if they exist
- I'll coordinate DocuSign routing once we have a signed draft

Would a target of EOW Apr 15 for a draft work for procurement? If not, tell us the cut-off and we'll prioritize.

Best,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Enterprise Account Lead
Redwood Inference
sergio@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: none

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@sierraholdings.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Draft temporary assertion (SOC 2 Type II) — request for review

Hi Elena, Sergio —

Attached is a draft temporary assertion we propose to cover the period following the SOC 2 Type II report ending 31 December 2023 through the date of signing. Key points:
- The assertion explicitly references our SOC 2 Type II report dated 2023-12-31 (report attached for reference).
- Statement provided: "To the best of our knowledge and based on our control governance processes, there have been no material changes to the in-scope controls since the report period."
- If procurement requires date-bounded language instead of "to the date of signing," we can change the wording to a fixed range (e.g., 2024-01-01 through 2027-04-18).
- Marissa has confirmed no material control changes affecting in-scope systems; any minor operational changes are documented and non-impactful to control objectives (Marissa can provide a short summary if you need it in the letter).

Please redline the attached Word draft (temporary_assertion_draft.docx) and advise whether your legal/procurement team needs additional evidence (e.g., recent vulnerability scan summary, change-log extract). We can execute via DocuSign once wording is agreed.

Thanks — aiming to get this signed before Sierra's procurement deadline.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: temporary_assertion_draft.docx (draft), SOC2_TypeII_report_2023-12-31.pdf (report stub)

From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@sierraholdings.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@sierraholdings.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft temporary assertion (SOC 2 Type II) — request for review

Laura — thanks for the quick turnaround and for including the report. The draft looks good overall. A couple of small asks from procurement/legal before we proceed to signature:
- Can you add a one-sentence clause confirming the assertion does not alter the scope of the original SOC 2 report (i.e., it is limited to continuity/assurance only)?
- Please confirm the fixed date range option. Procurement prefers a fixed range 2024-01-01 through 2027-04-18 for their records.

We attached the PO for our purchase order (PO_89123.pdf). Once you confirm the wording we can route DocuSign; Samir will sign on behalf of Sierra.

Appreciate the help — if you can get the final version back today or tomorrow that would keep us on track.

Best,
Elena
Attachment: PO_89123.pdf (stub)
